title: FIFO queue using two LIFO stacks
summary: Build a simple queue using Python lists as stacks. Push and pop at the end of a list, and peek at its last element without removing it.
triggers: implement a linear queue with stack operations
defer reversing a batch until the output stack is empty
prompts: Serve print jobs in arrival order using storage that only allows access to the top.
Implement a waiting line whose front can be inspected repeatedly without removing anyone.
invariant: The queue reads from the top of outgoing down, then from the bottom of incoming up.
mantra: Transfer only when the output stack is empty.
pitfalls: Refilling a nonempty output stack lets newer arrivals jump ahead of older ones.

anchors.name: Implement Queue using Stacks
anchors.trick: Each item moves between stacks at most once.

complexity.time: O(1) amortized per operation, O(n) for a transfer

mutations.explanation: Transfers new arrivals on top of items that were already waiting to leave.

test: raise AssertionError("empty queue returned an item")
